mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PHYS-TO-COLD CONVERSION single-target striker. [negative=1 kit -- mapping records what the kit WAS; the negative_canon flag lives on the corpus row, NOT in this mapping_json, per batch instruction. Confirmed obsolete/niche ('melee strike skill in modern POE' listed as a con) but its identity maps cleanly.] Geometry melee_strike (dossier: 'at-target melee strike, single target point'). ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL is the exact capstone T4 -- the skill's defining act is converting 100% physical to cold (crosswalk s5 phys-to-X row). water/cold family; chill+freeze -- and critically the ENGINE'S NATIVE freeze-expiry-under-threshold SHATTER (ailments.yaml freeze: shatter_threshold_fraction 0.25) is a DIRECT match to Glacial Hammer's 'frozen enemy below 1/3 life shatters when hit', so the shatter identity is native, not approximated. The 'every 3rd hit 200-390% more' is a cadence-counter behavioral property (no enum carrier) noted in traits. Herald of Ice shatter-clear is a secondary. Clean map despite the negative flag.
mapping_json.motion_frame: single-target cold bruiser: swing a mace that freezes; land the every-3rd-hit power stroke to freeze, then shatter frozen low-life enemies -- a slow, deliberate melee cadence
